notes:
## Supplier & customer opening balance fix

- Opening balance is now fixed history: receipts/payments no longer reduce it. The full amount posts to the customer credit / supplier balance delta, so the ledger closing balance and the list balance always agree.
- Editing or deleting a receipt/payment reverses the full amount from the delta column.
- One-time repair migration (`party_balance_fix_v1`) restores opening balances consumed by older builds and recovers overpayments whose remainder was previously dropped. Runs automatically once on first launch.
- Customer Edit modal now prefills Opening Balance from `opening_balance` only (not the credit delta), so saving cannot overwrite it.
- Advances/overpayments now show as a negative party balance instead of disappearing.
